TaskForce is moving to your desktop.

Your projects, tasks and notes, together in one app. And the Claude Code AI when a task needs a hand.

Download for Windows

Windows 10 and 11. Also on Linux, and soon on Mac.

Hi Alex,

You were one of the first people to use TaskForce, so you are among the first to hear it: TaskForce is now a desktop app. Same account, same interface, and your work stays with you.

A closer look

Plan, hand over, remember.

PlanProjects, tasks and a roadmap, on one board. Hand overGive a task to Claude Code: it gets on with it, on your computer. RememberYour notes link to each other and to your projects, in the Brain OS.

It all stays with you. Your projects live on your computer, the app collects nothing about how you use it, and it works without internet after the first sign-in.

On Windows

Three steps, and you are in.

If Windows shows a warning, that is expected: the app does not have the digital signature of the big publishers yet. The install guide explains each message, and the VirusTotal report shows the file scanned by dozens of antivirus programs.

Need a hand? Email me and I will walk you through it.

After that, the app updates itself.

Your work

Bring it along, or start fresh.

I already use TaskForce

Sign in with the same account, then click Operations, From the web app, Copy everything: your workspaces arrive with their projects and notes.

It is a copy: the web version keeps everything until it closes (date to come, an email will tell you). To redo by hand: your teammates, connected tools and AI settings.

How to bring your work

I'm starting fresh

Create your free account from the app, go through the three-step setup, then create your first project.

Claude Code turns on in one click in Settings, Agents, if it is installed on your computer and signed in to your Claude account.
